aboutGallery.quote: I don't paint what I see — I paint what I feel.
aboutGallery.title: Painting Since Childhood
aboutGallery.paragraph1: Art has always been my first language. Long before I had the words to express what I felt, I had colors, lines, and the patience of a blank canvas waiting to become something special. I started painting as a child — not because I was taught, but because I couldn't stop.
aboutGallery.paragraph2: My works have found their way into the homes of local collectors, and I am proud that pieces I created out of passion now hang on walls beyond my own world. For me, art is not just a career choice — it is the most honest thing I know how to do.

biography.title: The Artist's Journey
biography.paragraph1: Art has always been my first language. Long before I had words for what I felt, I had colours, lines, and the quiet patience of a blank canvas waiting to become something. I have been painting since childhood — not because someone taught me to, but because I could not stop.
biography.paragraph2: Over the years, I have developed my craft entirely through practice, observation, and an obsessive attention to detail. Every painting I create is an attempt to slow the world down — to capture a feeling, a moment, or a truth that words cannot quite reach. I work across styles and techniques, always exploring, never settling.
biography.paragraph3: My work has found its way into the homes of collectors locally, and I am proud that pieces I created purely from passion now live on walls beyond my own. Art, for me, is not a career choice — it is the most honest thing I know how to do.
biography.quote: I do not paint what I see — I paint what I feel.

practice.title: Artistic Practice
practice.description: A self-taught journey through painting, drawing, and mixed media.
practice.item1: Self-taught visual artist with over a decade of continuous practice in painting and drawing.
practice.item2: Specialises in expressive, detail-oriented works that convey emotion, depth, and narrative.
practice.item3: Explores a wide range of styles including realism, portraiture, and abstract expression.
practice.item4: Works primarily with acrylic, watercolour, and mixed media on canvas and paper.
practice.item5: Known for meticulous attention to detail and the ability to translate feelings into visual form.

experience.title: Selected Experience
experience.point1: Produced and sold original paintings to private collectors across Palestine.
experience.point2: Built an engaged online audience through Instagram (@nana.artist1), showcasing original works and creative process.
experience.point3: Managed all aspects of artistic production independently — from concept and creation to presentation and sale.
experience.point4: Developed a distinctive personal style recognised and sought after by local buyers.
